programme.title: Fantus And The Machines
programme.desc: Follow Fantus to see what an asphalt layer machine does!

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Peppa and George are playing in Grandpa Pig's garden. Peppa pretends to be a butterfly. Grandpa Pig shows George how to play at being a wriggly worm. Then they all have fun jumping in muddy puddles, pretending to be frogs.

programme.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
programme.desc: Join The Wiggles for animal dances! John wants to learn how to dance like a dog, and Wags the Dog is here to teach him some tail-wagging moves. Let's Ready, Steady, Wiggle and have fun with Wags!

programme.title: Shaun the Sheep
programme.desc: The sly fox tries to take advantage of the animals on the farm being distracted whilst cheering on Shaun who was playing Bitzer in the greatest ping pong match ever.

programme.title: Spidey and His Amazing Friends
programme.desc: Team Spidey is planting trees in the park, but Green Goblin interrupts by spewing gas everywhere.

programme.title: Supertato

programme.title: Superkitties
programme.desc: The SuperKitties stop Cat Burglar from stealing the trendy new hats in Kittydale. Buddy doesn't give up on learning how to use a telescope.

programme.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
programme.desc: Queen Thistle reads the children a story about the stars, and they all wonder where the stars go in the daytime. They can't find the answer in the magic books, so go instead to the Wise Old Elf in the Great Elf Library.

programme.title: Flower & Flour
programme.desc: When Flower discovers Flour is "35 in cat years," she decides he needs her extra-special care. She and Unicorn Cuzzy build a luxurious cat palace for him, but soon learn that age is just a number.

programme.title: Flower & Flour
programme.desc: Using a forgotten CD player, Flower and Flour start a game of musical statues, but soon discover Unicorn Cuzzy isn't very good at standing still. Instead, she finds her place in the game in her own unique way.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Peppa and her family are going for a walk in the countryside and end up climbing a big hill. When they get to the top there is a wonderful view.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: A long time ago, Granny and Grandpa were hippies. They still use hippy words like "groovy" which Peppa finds funny.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: As Mum goes for a walk along the beach, Bluey runs to catch up with her. Along the way, she has a series of encounters that both excite and test her in her first solo adventure.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: It's an adventure on the high seas as Bluey, Bingo and Missy play Pirates on the hammock swing, but they'll need to find their courage to withstand storms and whale attacks.

programme.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
programme.desc: When a young Watermelonsuchus gets beached during a heatwave, Ginger and the Baby Pea Rexes have to get creative to work out a way to get the giant baby into the water.

programme.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Split chases a glowing Chillipede into the depths of the Spooky Forest and gets lost inside an overgrown tree-root maze, where the only way out is to follow the sounds of Ginger and the other Baby Pea-Rexes.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: After bumping his head, Gadabout forgets he ever became a doctor and returns to his knightly ways. Zog and Pearl show him the bravest thing you can do is care for others.

programme.title: Hey Duggee

programme.desc: Spring has sprung! There are cute baby animals to meet and frolic with, Hennie bounces around in new dance shoes, and Happy loves water as much as Roly loves potatoes!

programme.title: Gardening Australia Junior
programme.desc: Lots of things in the garden seem a bit gross - compost, slugs, spider webs, poo, worms, but all have a purpose. And Costa will prove that the purpose is. beautiful!

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: Kitty asks the Piggies to build a bouncing machine. Taking too long, she ends up doing it herself--leading to bouncy chaos!

programme.desc: Santi and crew will have to team up with a pirate puppy to stop Bonnie Bones and save an old friend. / Enrique's new gold-digging machine threatens Lorelai's home.
